_comment: Committed content for the extraction family (B-21 S1d): rubric-guided extraction. The tracked variant states several candidate mentions with statuses (confirmed / considered / cancelled / hypothetical) and the rubric selects the FINAL CONFIRMED one - ignore cancelled plans and hypothetical alternatives, 'unknown' when nothing is confirmed (the bench 'extraction' shape, both tiers). The simple variant is the single-mention 'easy' shape. Labels are the drawn values plus 'unknown', derived from the mention facts through the tree (ADR-0014/15); option order is permuted (W1.4 hygiene).
